HowItWorks.title: How Chambé works
HowItWorks.body: A short path from describing the job to a vetted contractor on site.
HowItWorks.intro: Three steps between describing a problem and a vetted pro fixing it — no cold calls, no five competing quotes to compare, no guesswork.
HowItWorks.step1Body: Describe what needs fixing in your own words — a leaky faucet, a dead outlet, a fence that needs rebuilding. Add a few photos if you have them. It takes about two minutes, and there's no account to create.
HowItWorks.step2Body: Our pricing engine reads your job description, matches it against a real GTA pricebook, and gives you an itemized price range in seconds. It is not a marketing number designed to get you on the phone — it is a deterministic estimate built from labor hours, material costs, and job complexity. If we are not confident enough in the estimate, we will say so and ask a couple of clarifying questions instead of guessing.
HowItWorks.step3Title: Get matched with a vetted pro
HowItWorks.step3Body: We match your job to background-checked, insured contractors who work in your neighbourhood and specialize in your trade, using a scoring system that weighs proximity, reliability, and responsiveness. {match} {callback}
HowItWorks.ctaBody: It takes about two minutes and costs nothing.

About.title: Our mission
About.body: We match homeowners in Toronto and the GTA with vetted local contractors.
About.p1: Hiring a contractor in Toronto shouldn't feel like a gamble. Too many homeowners in the GTA have a story about a no-show, a quote that tripled once the work started, or a job that just never got finished. That gap between "I need this fixed" and "someone reliable is doing it, at a fair price" is what Chambé is built to close.
About.p2: We do that two ways. First, transparent pricing: every estimate comes from a deterministic pricing engine built on real GTA labor rates and material costs, not a sales rep's gut feeling. Second, a vetted contractor network: every pro on Chambé is background-checked and insured, and the work on this site is from real completed jobs — no unlicensed subcontractor showing up in their place.
About.p3: We're a Toronto-based team serving homeowners and contractors across the GTA. Contractors are vetted before they take a job, and every estimate is priced from real local labour rates — not a sales call.
About.homeownersBody: A real price in seconds, matched with a contractor we'd actually hire ourselves.

Gallery.title: Real jobs, real results
Gallery.body: Completed work from Chambé contractors. Tap a pin to see the job.
Gallery.ctaBody: Get a free estimate — no account required.

etobicoke-deck.title: New backyard deck
etobicoke-deck.description: The backyard was just grass. We laid out and dug the footings, poured the concrete, built the whole deck, then sanded and stained the wood.

downtown-kitchen.title: Kitchen renovation
downtown-kitchen.description: Top-to-bottom kitchen renovation: demoed the old kitchen, new drywall and taping, two new circuits from the breaker for the microwave, oven, fridge, and dishwasher we installed, new plumbing, a tiled backsplash, and the main floor painted white with new window and door trim, baseboards, and a yellow front door. A Blink video doorbell was also installed.

black-forest-lane-barrie.title: Exterior roofline trim
black-forest-lane-barrie.description: Installed white wood trim boards under the second-floor roofline and overhang.

lippincott-toronto.title: Full-house framing and envelope
lippincott-toronto.description: Demolished the existing house, then framed the new build from the roof down — walls, stairs, all of it. Insulation, sheathing, and Blueskin air and vapour barrier.

kenilworth-ceiling-light.title: Ceiling fan to pot light
kenilworth-ceiling-light.description: Demoed the old ceiling fan, cleared it out, installed a new pot light, and tested that it was working.

kenilworth-east-end.title: Basement bathroom and storage
kenilworth-east-end.description: Added storage space and a bathroom, plus a gas-dryer setup. We demoed small sections of concrete wall for more storage space, ran new electrical for the bathroom light, switch, and fan, installed HVAC ductwork to vent the gas dryer, then framed, drywalled, and taped the new walls ready for a cabinet installer.

titan-road-etobicoke.title: Warehouse partition wall
titan-road-etobicoke.description: Inside a commercial warehouse we framed a full-height industrial partition with metal studs, including a window opening, then insulated, drywalled, taped, and painted the entire wall. A large-scale commercial build — not a house job.
